Rina (Finance): Flag from PartnerCare: vendor Nebula noted a surprise $3.7k credit reversal on their April statement. Can billing ops take a look?
Sophie (Acct Rep): I pulled INV-2026-1543. There's a reversal line REV-NEB-0426 for $3,700 but Nebula says they never requested any promo.
Omar (Billing Ops): Scanning audit logs for acct neb-550. Looks like a meter misclassification rule fired and then an automated reconciliation rule reversed it. Logs:
`2026-04-26T09:12:04Z meter-classify acct=neb-550 rule=map-edge -> class=partner_promo`
`2026-04-26T09:12:06Z reconcile-auto acct=neb-550 detect=promo_mismatch action=reversal id=REV-NEB-0426 amt=3700`
Sophie (Acct Rep): So system applied promo erroneously then auto-reconciler reversed it. Customer sees reversal and got worried.
Rina (Finance): Policy: if reversal was system-initiated due to misclassification and customer didn't request it, issue a goodwill credit of the same amount and add note "goodwill for automated reversal confusion". Also add root-cause tag rc=meter-misclass-autorecon.
Omar (Billing Ops): Queuing goodwill credit: `vb credit --acct neb-550 --amount 3700 --currency USD --invoice INV-2026-1543 --code GW-REV-0426 --note "goodwill for automated reversal confusion"`
audit-bot: Action queued: manual_credit_pending | id=BILL-8802 | acct=neb-550 | amt=3700 USD
Sophie (Acct Rep): I'll send customer note: "We see an automated reversal happened after a meter misclassification. Weve posted a goodwill credit of $3,700 to make you whole and are fixing the classification rule. Sorry for the confusion."
Rina (Finance): Approved. Omar please tag finance when txn posts and add the incident to the billing postmortems board.
